name: Coinbase Global
exposure: Crypto trading fees, custody and stablecoin-related revenue; affected by trading activity, regulation and platform-security news.

name: Strategy
exposure: Bitcoin treasury value and financing; common stock has amplified Bitcoin exposure alongside capital-structure risks.

name: Robinhood Markets
exposure: Customer crypto trading and digital-asset services; crypto is one part of a diversified brokerage business.

name: Circle Internet Group
exposure: USDC circulation, adoption and reserve income; stablecoin regulation and interest rates matter independently of Bitcoin prices.

name: MARA Holdings
exposure: Bitcoin mining economics and treasury; compute-infrastructure expansion, financing and power costs are competing drivers.

name: Riot Platforms
exposure: Bitcoin mining revenue and treasury alongside data-center strategy; network difficulty, electricity costs and AI infrastructure also matter.

name: Block
exposure: Corporate Bitcoin holdings, Cash App Bitcoin services and Bitcoin hardware; payments remain another major business driver.

name: PayPal Holdings
exposure: Consumer crypto services and the PYUSD commercial relationship; diversified payments exposure rather than a Bitcoin treasury proxy.

name: CME Group
exposure: Cryptocurrency futures/options trading and clearing within a diversified exchange; volatility can raise activity even when crypto prices fall.

name: BlackRock
exposure: Digital-asset fund management and sponsorship economics; ETF Bitcoin assets belong to the funds and are not BlackRock corporate treasury holdings.
